title: Auto-Capture and Route Website Leads in Zoho CRM #Shorts
description:
Yettel Hungary now offers Zoho CRM and Zoho One to businesses. Here is how to stop typing website leads in by hand: a native Zoho CRM webform plus assignment and workflow rules.

1. Open Setup › Channels › Webforms in Zoho CRM and click New Form to build your lead form
2. Go to Setup › Automation › Assignment Rules to route new leads to the right rep by territory
3. Go to Setup › Automation › Workflow Rules to email the rep the moment a lead is created

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxQNWk5ekp4ODFHWHNGZ0d4Rzd1Nmx4NmxIMFZrZ2F3U0VDX1NYSkRXbzVoVnhHS080ZzItaHJUUEpEMW1NVWZZZmFfZFJocGtrTGsxdnhHZ0UxUmswRXlpMUhadjlab29wM05WZ0lQemh2N2V3Slc0VHpGalRYYUdKZGJ4ZjM2SGlkdWVjY28zUnk5dWhMOGc?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

angle.problem: Businesses moving onto Zoho CRM (e.g. via Yettel Hungary, a new Zoho partner) still copy website inquiries in by hand.
angle.solution: Configure web-to-lead forms and automated assignment rules in Zoho CRM to convert inbound web traffic instantly.
steps: Open Setup > Channels > Webforms in Zoho CRM and click New Form to build your lead form
Go to Setup > Automation > Assignment Rules to route new leads to the right rep by territory
Go to Setup > Automation > Workflow Rules to email the rep the moment a lead is created
angle.result: Every website lead lands in Zoho CRM, reaches the right rep and triggers an alert, with no manual data entry
angle.wow: Website leads routed to the right rep automatically, with no code.
angle.hook: Yettel Hungary now sells Zoho CRM to businesses - here is the first automation to set up.
